import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if j != i:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i][j - 1]) % MOD
            if i != 0:
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j]) % MOD
    ans = 0
    for j in range(n, -1, -1):
        for i in range(j - 1, -1, -2):
            ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
